fusions.name: Felling Leap
fusions.desc: Bounds onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away and chops down, dealing 15 slashing damage, rising to 1.6 times that at 6 tiles.

fusions.name: Last Notch
fusions.desc: Chops an enemy at or below 25% health for 22 slashing damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Then your movement speed rises by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Whetted on Bark
fusions.desc: You spring 2 tiles, and your slashing damage rises by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Hewing Antlers
fusions.desc: Conjures a weapon. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your movement speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
